info.title: swarmy API
info.description: Public, versioned REST API for swarmy. Authenticate with an org-scoped API key: `Authorization: Bearer swk_…`.

bearerApiKey.description: swarmy API key (`Authorization: Bearer swk_…`), or an OAuth access token swarmy issued for its APIs (scopes `swarmy:read` / `swarmy:write`).

last_error.description: The most recent task error Swarm reported (why it is failing); detail responses only.

IngressWwwMode.description: Apex ↔ www pairing for the host: serve the apex and 308 www onto it, serve www and 308 the apex onto it, or serve both.

reason.description: One plain-words sentence explaining the state.

gated.description: Withheld from the edge until DNS points at swarmy — no certificate is requested meanwhile.

id.description: `<serviceId>:<host>` (+ `/<path>` for a path route). URL-encode it in paths.

label.description: What most registrar UIs want in the host box (`@`, `www`, `app`).

GitConnectionKind.description: Git provider kind. Open enum — new kinds may be added.

account.description: Provider account the credential acts as, when known.

status.description: `active` or `pending` (an OAuth grant not yet completed).

mode.description: GitLab only. `token` (default) — only mode available over REST; `oauth` needs a browser and is refused.

base_url.description: Provider base URL. Defaults to https://gitlab.com for GitLab; required for gitea/generic.

token.description: Access token. Required for GitLab (≥ 8 chars), optional for gitea/generic. Write-only; never returned.

token_user.description: HTTP basic username the token is sent as (gitea/generic; default `git`).

require_approval.description: GitOps: every planned step waits for confirmation. Set via PUT /apps/{repoId}/require-approval.

enforce_drift.description: GitOps: drift on git-owned fields is re-applied. Set via PUT /apps/{repoId}/enforce-drift.

secret.description: HMAC secret. WRITE-ONCE: returned only by this response.

webhook.description: Webhook to configure on the git host when swarmy could not register it itself (null for GitHub App / auto-registered GitLab hooks). WRITE-ONCE: never returned again.

deploy_key_public.description: Public deploy key to add to the git host. WRITE-ONCE: never returned again.

repo.description: A picked provider repo. Give exactly one of `repo` or `url`.

url.description: Raw clone URL (generic git). Give exactly one of `repo` or `url`.

config_path.description: Path of the swarmy.yaml to apply (default `swarmy.yaml`).

deploy_key.description: Mint an ed25519 deploy key (SSH remotes). Its public half is returned once.

kept_volumes.description: Removed Postgres clusters whose data is still on disk — delete via POST …/environments/{environment}/purge.

branch.description: Branch of a branch preview (absent for PR previews).

from.description: Environment whose latest backup was copied.

scrub.description: Scrub script/profile applied to the copy.

data.description: Preview with data: a COPY of this environment’s latest backup, destroyed with the preview.

previews.description: Live PR previews (latest plan per PR).

drift.description: The last drift check (refreshed by the controller every ~10 min); null = not checked yet.

AppPlanGate.description: `auto` runs on its own, `confirm` waits for POST /apps/plans/{planId}/confirm, `blocked` cannot run.

trigger.description: push, pr, manual, poll, drift, confirm (open set).

status.description: Plan row status, e.g. planned, needs-confirmation, applying, applied, failed, superseded (open set).

plan_status.description: noop, ready, needs-confirmation, blocked — null when the config did not parse.

markdown.description: The plan as the PR comment renders it.

allOf.description: The plan the deploy recorded (null when nothing was planned).

branch.description: Branch head to plan + apply (default: the production branch).

nodes.description: Online nodes the volumes were removed from.

confirm.description: Must be exactly `<stack>/<resource>` — the typed confirmation.

from.description: Named environment to promote to production.

id.description: API key id, or `oauth:<client_id>` for an OAuth token.

value.description: null = withheld (a secret this call may not read).

secret.description: A secret variable (Docker secret), or a plain value that looks secret.

delivery.description: How a secret variable reaches the process; null for plain.

error.description: Why a requested reveal failed (e.g. no running task).

secrets_readable.description: Whether the principal holds ABAC `secrets.read` on this service.

set.description: Plain variables to add or change.

secrets.description: Secret variables to create or rotate. Stored as Docker secrets; never readable back without `secrets.read`.

ts.description: Unix ms, when Docker stamped the line.

phase.description: converging, complete, failed, rolledback, canceled (open set).

dsn.description: The Sentry-compatible DSN apps send to.

store_enabled.description: Whether the observability store (ClickHouse) is on.

pending_redeploy.description: Opted-in services that need a redeploy to receive SENTRY_DSN.

post.summary: Drain a node (cordon — stop scheduling, move tasks off)
Cordon a node (alias of drain)
Uncordon a node (restore availability `active`)
Create a service (async deploy)
Scale a service (async deploy)
Restart a service (async deploy)
Deploy a stack from a compose document (async)
Add an ingress domain

get.description: Lifecycle state (waiting_dns → verified → issuing → active | error), the exact DNS records to create, what public DNS answers, and the certificate each edge serves.

post.summary: Re-check a domain now
post.description: Runs the DNS (and, once verified, certificate) check immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

post.summary: Create an API key (plaintext returned once)

201.description: Created — carries the plaintext key (shown once)

post.summary: Create a DNS zone

get.summary: Check registrar delegation for a zone
get.description: Public NS lookup compared to the advertised nameserver set, plus a direct SOA probe of each glue IP.

get.summary: List manual records in a zone (MX/TXT/CNAME/…)

post.summary: Create or update a manual record (upsert by name+type+value)
Add a backup target (restic repo)
Back up a volume now (creates a snapshot)
Restore a snapshot into a volume
Register + provision a cluster volume
Grant a direct mesh route to a service/stack

get.summary: Export the org audit log (CSV or JSON, max 10 000 rows)

200.description: The export body. `X-Swarmy-Row-Count` carries the row count; `X-Swarmy-Truncated: true` means the filter matched more than the 10k cap.

post.summary: Send an email through the org’s Email service
post.description: Hands the message to the org’s Email service (direct delivery or the domain’s relay, as set on the Email page). Needs Email turned on with a verified domain.

post.summary: Create a registry credential (or rotate the login for an existing prefix)

patch.summary: Update a registry credential (username/label, or rotate the secret)

post.summary: Test a stored credential (registry v2 auth; manifest HEAD when `image` is given)

get.summary: List git provider connections (credentials never returned)

post.summary: Connect a GitLab (token), Gitea or generic git host
post.description: GitHub App and GitLab OAuth connections need a browser and are refused with `422` (`swarmy_code: BROWSER_FLOW_REQUIRED`) — make those in the dashboard. A GitLab token is verified against the provider before it is saved. Admin/owner only.

get.summary: List repositories the connection can see (the provider's repo picker)
get.description: Generic git hosts have no listing API and return an empty list — link them by URL.

get.summary: List branches of a repository visible to the connection

post.summary: Link a repository (branch + swarmy.yaml path) as an app binding
post.description: Give either a picked provider `repo` (with its `connection_id`) or a raw `url`. The response carries the webhook secret and deploy-key public half ONCE — store them; no read returns them again. Admin/owner only.

patch.summary: Change a linked repository's branch and/or swarmy.yaml path in place
patch.description: Admin/owner only. The next push/poll plans against the new branch/path.

get.summary: List GitOps apps (linked repos) with each environment’s latest plan

post.summary: Confirm held steps of a plan, then apply them
post.description: Each step is authorized by what it destroys (data.destroy / service.remove / stack.deploy); a step the key’s principal may not confirm fails the whole call with `403`. Ids that are not held (or no longer planned) are ignored.

put.summary: Set the app’s require-approval toggle (every step waits for confirmation)

post.summary: Plan and apply the head of a branch now
post.description: Runs the same plan → apply as a push (destructive steps still wait for confirmation). Returns when the plan is recorded and its runnable part applied. Admin/owner only.

get.summary: Compare each environment’s last applied commit with live state (changes nothing)
get.description: An empty list means no drift.

put.summary: Opt in (or out) of re-applying drift on git-owned fields
put.description: Default is report-only. When on, drift is re-applied as a `drift`-triggered plan; destructive steps still wait for confirmation. Admin/owner only.

post.summary: Delete a REMOVED managed Postgres’s data permanently (its volumes on every node)
post.description: Irreversible. Requires `data.destroy` (checked at the route AND per resource in the service) and the typed confirmation `confirm: "<stack>/<resource>"`. Refused (400) while swarmy.yaml still declares the resource, its removal is not yet confirmed, or it is still running.

post.summary: Promote a named environment’s running image digests (e.g. staging) to production
post.description: No rebuild: production is planned with the digests the source environment runs now, through the same gates (destructive steps still wait). Admin/owner only.

get.summary: Who this credential acts as, and what it may do

get.description: Plain variables with their values; secret variables (and plain values that look secret) with `value: null` unless `reveal_secrets=true` AND the key holds the `secrets.read` scope AND policy permits `secrets.read` on the service. Every reveal is audited.

patch.description: Keys not named are kept exactly (secret variables included). `secrets` become Docker secrets (new versions, rolling update). Policy: `service.configure` on the service.

get.summary: The last lines of a service’s logs (all tasks)

schema.description: Unix seconds; only lines after this time.

get.description: Each `data:` event is one LogLine as JSON. The stream stays open until the client disconnects.

schema.description: Unix seconds; only lines after this time.

get.summary: A deployment’s convergence (poll until a terminal phase)

post.summary: Preview a branch (trial deploy)
post.description: Plans the branch’s swarmy.yaml and deploys it as a preview environment with its own stack and URL, the same machinery as a branch or pull-request preview. Torn down by `previews.ttl` or when the branch is deleted.

get.summary: Whether OpenTelemetry is on for a stack

put.summary: Turn OpenTelemetry on or off for a stack
put.description: Stamps/clears the stack’s telemetry label; the next deploy (un)injects OTEL_* env. Admin/owner only.

get.summary: Error tracking for a stack: opt-in state and the DSN

post.summary: Rotate the stack’s DSN key (the old key stops working at once)
post.description: Apps pick up the new DSN on their next deploy. Admin/owner only.
